items.title: 15.5.2 Peripheral Nervous System - Cranial & Spinal Nerves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cranial and spinal nerves (PDF 40-42).

blocks.text: Peripheral nervous system nerves, yaani axons ke taar jaise majmooe, aur ganglia, yaani CNS ke bahar cell bodies ke guchhon, par mushtamil hai. Dimagh se nikalne wali nerves cranial nerves aur spinal cord se nikalne wali spinal nerves hain.

Cranial nerves ke 12 jore hain. Kitab kehti hai pehle do jore (olfactory aur optic) cerebrum se aur baqi das brainstem se nikalte hain. Kuch sensory, kuch motor aur kuch mixed (sensory aur motor dono neurons ke axons wali) hain.

blocks.caption: Cranial nerves ke barah jore

blocks.alt: Dimagh ka nichla hissa (cerebrum, pons, medulla, cerebellum, spinal cord) aur aage se peeche tartib se cranial nerves ke barah jore: cerebrum se I olfactory aur II optic (sensory); brainstem se III oculomotor, IV trochlear aur VI abducens (motor), V trigeminal aur VII facial (mixed), VIII vestibulocochlear (sensory), IX glossopharyngeal aur X vagus (mixed), XI accessory aur XII hypoglossal (motor). Sensory neele, motor laal, mixed jamni (purple).
blocks.caption: Dimagh ke neeche se dekhe gaye cranial nerves ke barah jore (Figure 15.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Table ke saath parhein: har nerve ka rang batata hai ke woh sensory, motor ya mixed hai. Pehle do jore cerebrum se aur baqi das brainstem se nikalte hain; vagus (X) akela nerve hai jo seene aur pet ke aaza (organs) tak pohanchta hai.

blocks.text: Spinal nerves ke 31 jore hain, sab mixed, jo spinal cord aur baqi jism ke darmiyan sensory aur motor maloomat le jate hain. Har nerve cord se do chhoti jaron se nikalti hai: dorsal root sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites le jati hai, jin ke cell bodies cord ke bahar dorsal root ganglion mein ikatthe hain, aur ventral root motor neurons ke axons le jati hai, jin ke cell bodies cord ke andar hain. Dono jarein vertebral column se nikalne se zara pehle mil jati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: bahar se andar meninges ki tahein: haddi, moti dura mater, patli arachnoid, cerebrospinal fluid wali jagah, nazuk pia mater, phir dimagh ya spinal cord. Daen: spinal cord ki tarash, white matter ka bayzavi hissa jis ke andar H-numa grey matter aur central canal; har taraf ganglion wali dorsal root aur ventral root mil kar spinal nerve banati hain. Note spinal nerves ke 31 jore ginta hai.
blocks.caption: Spinal nerves aur un ki jarein (Figure 15.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teen meninges dimagh aur spinal cord ko dhakti hain: bari nalyon wali moti bahari dura mater, patli arachnoid jo apne neeche ke cerebrospinal fluid ko dura ke khoon se alag rakhti hai, aur sateh par nazuk pia mater jis ki capillaries tissue ko ghiza deti hain. Spinal cord mein tarteeb dimagh se ulti hai: grey matter (inter-neurons aur motor neurons ke cell bodies) andar ka H banata, white matter (myelin wale axons) bahar ka hissa, central canal ke gird jo chauthe ventricle se mila hua hai. Har spinal nerve dorsal root (sensory, cell bodies dorsal root ganglion mein) aur ventral root (motor) ke milne se banti hai. 31 jore hain: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral aur 1 coccygeal.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Optic nerve (II) ko aam taur par cerebrum ke bajaye diencephalon se juda bataya jata hai; kitab ise olfactory nerve ke saath cerebrum se nikalne wali ginti hai.

blocks.prompt: Spinal nerve ki dorsal root mein kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons: un ke axons aur dendrites, aur un ke cell bodies dorsal root ganglion mein.

items: Cranial nerves ke 12 jore (sensory, motor ya mixed; table dekhiye). Spinal nerves ke 31 jore, sab mixed: dorsal root sensory (ganglion), ventral root motor; 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 1 coccygeal.
